title.en: A feather that loses its air drag
title.zh: 羽毛的空气阻力被去掉

description.en: A silver iron ball and a white feather are released together in still air. The true clip keeps the feather's drag so it drifts down slowly; the counterfactual removes that drag and the feather lands within a few frames of the ball.
description.zh: 银铁球和白羽毛从同一高度同时释放。真值里空气阻力让羽毛慢慢飘落，铁球先落地；反事实里羽毛的空气阻力在介入帧被去掉，它掉得和铁球一样快，几帧之内先后落地。

title.en: An iron ball with an anomalous gravitational acceleration
title.zh: 真空舱里铁球拿到异常大的重力加速度

description.en: Inside an evacuated chamber the ball and the feather fall straight down and land in the same frame or the next. The counterfactual gives the iron ball an anomalously larger gravitational acceleration, so it lands first while the feather is still in the air.
description.zh: 透明真空舱里铁球和羽毛从同一高度同时释放。真值里几乎没有空气阻力，两者直直落下、几乎同时落地。反事实里铁球得到异常大的重力加速度，抢先落地，羽毛还在上面。

title.zh: 互感电流在断电后仍然留着
title.en: An induced current that outlives the circuit

description.zh: 两只线圈套在同一根铁芯上，其中一只接在交流电源上。真值里断电之后感应电流很快衰减掉；反事实里互感的贡献被保留下来，断电之后线圈里仍然有一份电流在走，测量表上的读数停在非零的位置。
description.en: Two coils sit on the same iron core and one of them is wired to an alternating supply. In the true clip the induced current decays quickly once the supply is switched off; in the counterfactual the contribution of the mutual induction is kept, so a current is still flowing in the coil after the power is gone and the meter reading stays away from zero.

title.zh: 带电棒移开以后，验电器的叶片没有合上
title.en: The leaves of an electroscope do not close after the rod is taken away

description.zh: 一支带电棒靠近验电器的金属球，叶片被感应电荷推开。真值里棒移开以后叶片慢慢合回；反事实里感应的电荷留在了球上，叶片一直张着，合不回去。
description.en: A charged rod is brought near the metal ball of an electroscope and the leaves are pushed apart by the induced charge. In the true clip the leaves close again slowly once the rod is taken away; in the counterfactual the induced charge stays on the ball and the leaves keep standing open instead of closing.

title.zh: 带电梳子没有把中性纸片吸起来
title.en: A charged comb that does not pick up the neutral paper

description.zh: 一把带电的梳子靠近悬空的中性纸片。真值里纸片被电荷梯度吸起来，跟着梳子走；反事实里这层极化没有发生，纸片在原地轻轻晃着，不被吸起。
description.en: A charged comb is brought near a neutral scrap of paper hanging in the air. In the true clip the gradient of the field picks the paper up and it follows the comb; in the counterfactual that polarisation does not happen, the paper only sways where it is and is never lifted.

title.en: A side-release buckle that unlocks under a sideways pull
title.zh: 插扣扣合之后横向拉不动

description.en: Two halves of a nylon belt buckle seat and latch. In the true clip a sideways pull cannot separate them; in the counterfactual the lock never takes and the halves slide apart under the same pull.
description.zh: 尼龙腰带两半先沿插合轴推进，钩鼻让弹簧臂缩回、再卡到肩台后面扣合；真值里随后横向一拉，两半保持扣住、高度不变。反事实里锁止没有生效，横向一拉两半就错开脱开。

title.zh: 毛巾盖到球上，接触的隆起消失
title.en: A towel that no longer drapes over the ball it lands on

description.zh: 厚毛巾落到实心球上。真值里布面在球顶撑出一个明显的隆起，四角垂到桌面；反事实里毛巾直接穿过球，铺在球下面，接触该产生的隆起没有了。
description.en: A thick towel is released above a solid ball. In the true clip the cloth bulges into a visible bump over the top of the ball and the corners hang down to the table; in the counterfactual the towel passes through the ball and settles underneath it, and the bump the contact should have produced is gone.

title.zh: 薄壁铝罐在轴向压力下长出皱褶
title.en: A thin aluminium can that wrinkles under axial load

description.zh: 薄壁铝罐夹在两块压板之间受持续的轴向压力。真值里载荷低于临界屈曲，罐壁基本不变形、松开后恢复原状；反事实里同样的载荷让罐壁长出吉村型的菱形皱褶，而罐仍然是完整的。
description.en: A thin-walled aluminium can is held between two press plates under a steady axial load. In the true clip the load stays below the critical buckling load, the wall barely deforms and springs back when the plates release; in the counterfactual the same load makes the wall grow a Yoshimura-type diamond pattern, while the can itself stays intact.

title.en: A cotton strip that suddenly loses its axial stiffness
title.zh: 棉布条突然失去轴向刚度

description.en: A tensile frame slowly pulls a low-extension woven cotton strip. The true clip shows a small extension; the counterfactual shows the strip losing most of its axial stiffness, stretching far further and narrowing in the middle.
description.zh: 机架缓慢拉一条低伸长织棉布并保持住。真值里只有轻微伸长。反事实里棉条突然失去大部分轴向刚度，显著拉长，下夹具跟着下降更多，中部随伸长而收窄。

title.zh: 手风琴折纸桥失去抗弯刚度
title.en: A pleated paper bridge that loses its bending stiffness

description.zh: 同样纸做的平板和手风琴折纸桥各架在两组支座上，放上同样重的小砝码。真值里平板塌下去，折纸桥几乎不弯；反事实里折纸桥突然失去折叠带来的抗弯刚度，塌到和平板一样深——没有展开、没有撕裂、支座也没动。
description.en: A flat sheet of paper and an accordion-pleated paper bridge stand on two pairs of supports, each carrying the same small weight. In the true clip the flat sheet collapses while the pleated bridge barely bends; in the counterfactual the pleated bridge suddenly loses the bending stiffness that the folds gave it and sinks as deep as the flat sheet — without unfolding, without tearing, and with the supports untouched.

title.en: An electroscope shielded by a grounded mesh cage
title.zh: 接地铁网笼里的验电器不该被带电棒影响

description.en: A charged rod approaches two leaf electroscopes, one inside a grounded fine mesh cage. In the true clip the outside leaves spread while the shielded inside leaves stay closed; in the counterfactual the shielding fails and the inside leaves spread as well.
description.zh: 带电棒靠近两只叶验电器：一只在接地的细金属网笼里，一只在外面。真值里笼外那副叶片张开，笼内那副保持闭合；反事实里屏蔽失效，笼内的叶片也跟着张开。

title.zh: 三爪合拢夹住娃娃却没把它抬起来
title.en: Three claws close on the doll and still fail to lift it

description.zh: 三只爪子每一百二十度一只，相机这一侧的两只各咬住娃娃一侧最宽的地方，第三只从背后咬住；粗爪臂从爪心伸出、绕过娃娃肩膀再收回来，矮而宽的弧形胶垫贴着娃娃最宽的一圈合拢。真值支里爪子把娃娃整体抬离玻璃台面、悬在爪心下方；反事实支里爪子的走法一模一样：同样降到娃娃身上、同样合拢在娃娃腰上，可是胶垫始终没有咬住布娃娃，爪心空着升起，娃娃一整段视频一直站在台面上。
description.en: Three claws sit a hundred and twenty degrees apart, two of them gripping the widest part of a cloth doll and the third closing in from behind. In the true clip the claws lift the doll clear of the glass table and hold it under the claw hub; in the counterfactual the machine moves exactly the same way — it descends onto the doll and closes at the doll's waist — but the pads never grip the cloth, the hub rises empty and the doll stands on the table for the whole clip.

title.zh: 打字机回车后滑回行首并换行
title.en: A typewriter that returns to the margin and feeds a line

description.zh: 打字机打字时，带着打印头的那部分会慢慢往右走到行尾；按一下回车杆，联动带把它拉回行首，同时纸往上走一行。反事实里回车杆照样压下去，但联动带没套住凸轮销，凸轮空转，带着打印头的那部分停在行尾不回来，纸也不走。
description.en: While typing, the part of a typewriter that carries the print head walks slowly to the right margin; pressing the carriage lever pulls it back to the left margin and lifts the paper one line. In the counterfactual the lever is pressed exactly the same way, but the linkage misses the cam pin, the cam spins freely, the carriage stays at the right margin and the paper does not move.

title.en: A nickel tab that stays magnetised past the Curie point
title.zh: 镍摆片过了居里点仍然吸住磁铁

description.en: A nickel pendulum tab is heated past the Curie point of roughly 354 °C while it rests against a fixed magnet. In the true clip the attraction weakens until the tab separates and swings; in the counterfactual it wrongly keeps its strong ferromagnetic grip.
description.zh: 一片镍摆片贴在固定磁铁上，正面的电阻加热器把它加热到超过约 354 °C 的居里点，旁边有高温计读数。真值里磁性变弱，摆片脱开磁铁、在重力下摆动。反事实里高温下错误地保持强铁磁性，摆片仍然贴在磁铁上。

title.en: A page block that shears backwards under the press
title.zh: 书页受压却朝书脊方向错动

description.en: A motor-driven pad presses the outer edge of a clamped book. The page block shears away from the spine in the true clip; in the counterfactual the page block and the top cover shear back toward the spine, against the press.
description.zh: 一本书平放在台上，背封被两个夹爪压平，电机压垫压住封面外缘。真值里书页朝远离书脊的方向错动。反事实里书页与封面朝书脊方向错动，和压的方向正好相反，而底封和夹爪保持完整。

title.en: The upper string breaks first under a fast pull
title.zh: 快速下拉时先断的是上面那根绳

description.en: A weight hangs from two equally strong strings. In the true clip the lower string reaches its breaking tension first and the weight stays suspended from the upper one; in the counterfactual the upper string breaks first and the weight falls with the lower string intact.
description.zh: 一个重物用两根强度相同的绳吊住，上面一根、下面一根。真值里快速下拉，先到极限的是下面那根：它先断，安全扣释放，重物仍然吊在上面那根绳上。反事实里只有下绳达到极限，却先断的是上绳，重物带着完好的下绳一起掉下去。

title.zh: 报纸压尺的瞬态气阻失效
title.en: A newspaper's transient air resistance under a ruler

description.zh: 直尺压在平摊的报纸下面，一端伸出桌沿，对露出的一端做一次短促下压。真值里报纸下面那层被封住的空气给出短暂的压差阻力，抬起的一端只起来几毫米就被压回去；反事实里这层瞬态阻力消失，报纸明显抬起、离开桌面。
description.en: A ruler lies on a newspaper spread flat on the table, one end sticking out over the edge, and that end is pushed down once, briefly. In the true clip the air sealed under the paper gives a short-lived pressure difference that resists the lift, so the raised end comes up a few millimetres and is pushed back down; in the counterfactual that transient resistance is gone and the newspaper lifts clearly away from the table.

title.zh: 电源反接之后转矩方向还是错的
title.en: A motor whose torque stays wrong after the supply is reversed

description.zh: 剖视的永磁有刷直流电机由电池供电，一个看得见的双极开关断开触点再以相反极性接回，定子磁铁不动。真值里转子减速穿过零速然后反向转，不会在零速停住。反事实里反接之后电磁转矩方向仍然错，转子继续按原来的方向转。
description.en: A permanent-magnet brushed DC motor is cut open and driven from a battery through a visible two-pole switch that opens the contacts and closes them again with the opposite polarity, while the stator magnets stay put. In the true clip the rotor slows down through zero speed and then turns the other way, instead of stopping there; in the counterfactual the electromagnetic torque is still wrong after the reversal and the rotor keeps turning the way it was already turning.

title.zh: 吸盘漏气，玻璃板抬不起来
title.en: A suction cup that leaks and never grips

description.zh: 两个手动吸盘扣在玻璃板顶面靠近一边的位置，用杠杆连到吸盘柱塞。真值里按下杠杆，杯腔扩大、压力下降，两个吸盘咬住玻璃，松手后回弹弹簧收绳把板吊离台面。反事实里杯口漏气、建立不起低压，绳始终不绷紧，玻璃板一直躺在台面上。
description.en: Two hand-operated suction cups are pressed onto the top face of a glass sheet near one edge and linked by a lever to the cup plungers. In the true clip pressing the lever enlarges the cavity, the pressure falls, both cups grip the glass and a spring reel lifts the sheet off the table; in the counterfactual the cup rim leaks, no low pressure is built up, the cord never tightens and the glass stays lying on the table.

title.zh: 一排单摆的相位级联方向反转
title.en: A row of pendulums whose phase cascade runs backwards

description.zh: 一排 6–8 个单摆，绳长按几何级数递增所以周期呈等差阶梯。True 里各球依次到达摆动端点，从短绳端走向长绳端；反事实里绳长不再决定摆动快慢，整排在一个 1.4 秒的窗口里被重新计时，波峰收拢成一次共同的摆动，每个球都拿到同一个恢复长度，一起到达摆动端点。绳子一根没变，整排没有停过再重新起摆。
description.en: A row of six to eight pendulums hangs from a bar, the cord lengths growing geometrically so the periods form an arithmetic ladder. In the true clip the balls reach their turning points one after another, from the short end towards the long one; in the counterfactual the cord length no longer decides how fast a pendulum swings, the whole row is re-timed inside one 1.4 second window, the peaks collapse into a single shared swing and every ball gets the same restoring length and reaches the turning point together. Not one cord changed and the row never stopped and started again.

title.zh: 转盘上的硬币不再被科里奥利偏转
title.en: A coin that is not deflected by the turning table

description.zh: 挡销在介入时刻撤开。True 里硬币带着科里奥利项从画在盘面上、跟着盘一起转的释放半径弯开、绕着轴心扫过去，停在盘缘时明显偏到一侧；反事实只去掉这一项耦合，硬币沿同一条转动的半径直着出去。
description.en: The stop pin is pulled at the moment of intervention. In the true clip the coin leaves with the Coriolis term, bends away from the release radius painted on the table, sweeps around the axis and comes to rest clearly to one side at the rim; in the counterfactual only that coupling is removed and the coin runs straight out along the same rotating radius.

title.zh: 铅笔笔尖倒向相反的一侧
title.en: A pencil that topples to the other side

description.zh: 圆盘转到某一侧下倾，铅笔随即朝下倾的那一侧倒下。反事实只把圆盘的下倾方向反过来，铅笔、初始倾角和圆盘完全相同。
description.en: The disc tilts down towards one side and the pencil falls that way. The counterfactual reverses only the direction the disc tilts; the pencil, its starting lean and the disc are otherwise identical.

title.zh: 扣杆把钢球打飞，或者只把它挤出托座
title.en: The bar throws the ball clear, or only pushes it out of its seat

description.zh: 钢制挡片一松，扭簧驱动扣杆从顶部扫过：真支里杆头从球下面兜住黄球，把它抛成一道弧线落回台面；反事实里挡片同样松开、扣杆同样扫过顶部，但杆头没兜到球下面，只在球的侧面把球挤出托座，黄球直直落到立柱旁边的台面上。同一台机器、同一次释放，差别只在杆头碰到黄球那一刻。
description.en: A steel catch releases and a torsion spring drives the bar over the top. In the true clip the head of the bar scoops the yellow ball from underneath and throws it in an arc back onto the table; in the counterfactual the catch releases and the bar sweeps over the top just the same, but the head does not get under the ball — it only pushes the ball sideways out of its seat, and the yellow ball drops straight down onto the table beside the post. Same machine, same release; the difference is only in the moment the bar meets the ball.

title.zh: 橡皮筋没有解开，车没有动
title.en: A rubber band that never unwinds

description.zh: 释放是实验的、错误在驱动：True 里挡销倒下（脚固定在原地、只有上方翻倒），橡皮筋一圈圈松开并驱动后轮，车从坡顶沿斜坡往下滚、滚到半坡停住；反事实里挡销照样倒下，但橡皮筋始终绷紧、轮子不转，车整段停在坡顶不动。坡度两支相同。
description.en: The release is the experiment and the fault is in the drive: in the true clip the catch falls over (its foot stays planted, only the top tips over), the rubber band unwinds turn by turn and drives the rear wheel, and the car rolls down the slope and stops halfway; in the counterfactual the catch falls over exactly the same way, but the rubber band stays tight, the wheel does not turn and the car sits at the top of the slope for the whole clip. Both branches have the same slope.

title.zh: 滑行的后轮反过来带动脚踏
title.en: A freewheel that turns the pedals instead

description.zh: 自行车后轮在滚筒架上加速，链条松着，牙盘旁边有一个可接通的狗牙离合器。真值里离合器接的是花鼓上的棘轮，滑行时棘轮空转，曲柄和脚踏几乎不动。反事实里离合器把牙盘直接锁在轮上，滑行的轮子反过来驱动曲柄，踏板自己转起来。
description.en: The rear wheel of a bicycle accelerates on a roller rig with the chain slack and a dog clutch beside the chainring that can be engaged. In the true clip the clutch connects to the ratchet on the hub, so the ratchet freewheels while coasting and the crank and pedals hardly move; in the counterfactual the clutch locks the chainring straight onto the wheel, and the coasting wheel drives the crank the other way and turns the pedals by itself.

title.zh: 负载走了平台却没动
title.en: The load leaves, and the platform does not answer

description.zh: 钢制砝码压在弹簧平台上，平台整段上下起伏。True 里推杆把砝码横向推离平台、砝码落进旁边独立支架上的接料盘：负载走了，弹簧回升一截、平台升高一截、振荡周期跟着变短、节拍明显变快；反事实支里推杆照样推、驱动一模一样，平台却完全不理这次转移：弹簧还是被压着的那一档、平台还在原来那个低位上、振荡还是砝码在时那个慢节拍。
description.en: A steel weight presses on a spring platform that rises and falls for the whole clip. In the true clip a pusher slides the weight sideways off the platform and the weight drops into a catch tray on a separate stand: the load leaves, the spring rebounds, the platform rises and the period of the oscillation shortens, so the beat is clearly faster. In the counterfactual the pusher pushes exactly the same way and the drive is identical, but the platform does not answer the transfer at all: the spring stays on the same compressed step, the platform stays at the same low position and the oscillation keeps the slow beat it had while the weight was still there.

title.zh: 演示机芯的秒针倒着走
title.en: The seconds hand of a demonstration movement runs backwards

description.zh: 工坊墙上一只钟表匠的镂空演示机芯：六十秒刻度盘（黄铜圈、12 根刻线、0/15/30/45 四个凸起数字），盘后是带辐条的大轮（其中一根辐条漆成红色），盘前是蓝钢秒针，带配重尾与配重。真值支里秒针每秒走 6 度、从正上的 0 刻度顺时针扫向 15 再往下扫向 30，红辐条跟针同向转；反事实支里机芯的驱动接到另一边，秒针掉头往回扫、退回 0 刻度继续朝 45 刻度走，红辐条同时反向转。
description.en: An open demonstration movement hangs on the workshop wall: a sixty-second dial (a brass ring, twelve marks, four raised numerals at 0, 15, 30 and 45), a large spoked wheel behind it with one spoke painted red, and a blued-steel seconds hand in front with a weighted tail. In the true clip the hand advances six degrees a second, sweeping clockwise from 0 through 15 and on towards 30, and the red spoke turns the same way; in the counterfactual the drive is taken to the other side, the hand turns back on itself, retreats through 0 and carries on towards 45, and the red spoke turns the other way at the same time.

title.zh: 车床切螺纹切不出来
title.en: A lathe that does not cut the thread

description.zh: 小台车用卡盘夹着一根钢杆，主轴带着它转，一支黄色圆杆车刀沿轴向朝尾座进给，刀尖正好切在杆面上；靠卡盘那一端有一小段深色漆划痕，让旋转看得见。真值支里刃口是好的，刀尖后面在杆面上切出一条连续的螺旋槽：槽底是刀尖的宽度，两道直 flank 升到杆面，槽口比刀宽得多，两圈之间立着螺纹牙，牙顶与杆面齐平，是钢杆自己被切出来的那块金属；反事实支里两支走的方向和转向完全一样，从介入帧起刀刃崩了一块、切不动了，刃口在杆面上打滑，同一条槽里横着堆起一团撕裂的暗色金属，边是毛的、有断口，螺纹没有成形。
description.en: A small lathe holds a steel bar in its chuck and spins it while a yellow round-bar cutting tool feeds towards the tailstock with its tip on the bar; a short dark paint mark near the chuck makes the rotation visible. In the true clip the edge is sound and the tip cuts a continuous helical groove into the bar: the floor of the groove is the width of the tip, two straight flanks rise to the surface, the groove is much wider than the tool and thread crests stand between the turns, level with the bar, cut out of the steel itself. In the counterfactual both branches travel and turn exactly the same way, but from the intervention frame the edge chips, stops cutting, slips on the bar and tears a dark mass of metal sideways across the same groove with ragged broken edges — the thread never forms.

title.zh: 气流托不住乒乓球
title.en: An air jet that can no longer hold the ball up

description.zh: True 里风机维持全速、气柱一直托得住球，球在气流里上下晃动整段不落地；反事实气流衰减到托不住，球脱出气流掉进接球盘。
description.en: In the true clip the blower stays at full speed and the column of air keeps the ball up: it bobs in the jet and never lands for the whole clip. In the counterfactual the airflow decays until it can no longer hold the ball, and the ball drops out of the jet into the catch tray.

title.zh: 接触面冻住两块冰被一起拖走
title.en: The contact face freezes and drags both blocks along

description.zh: 两块冰并排立在钢制工作台上，右边那块被一只钢制夹爪咬住、夹爪的爪压在外侧面上、指压在顶面上、底脚踩在台面的导轨上，导轨左端立着一只钢制气缸，气缸的活塞杆顶在夹爪的立柱上、把夹爪和右边那块一起向右推。True 里两块的接触面没有结成冻结键合，右边那块直接从接触面滑脱，左边那块留在台面上没有动过；反事实里接触面长出一道白色的冻结缝，键合承住左边那块冰与台面之间的摩擦以后，左边那块被拖着和右边那块一起向右走。
description.en: Two ice blocks stand side by side on a steel table, the right one held by a steel clamp whose finger presses its outer face and whose foot rides the rails of the table; a steel cylinder at the left end of the rails pushes the clamp, and with it the right block, to the right. In the true clip the contact face between the two blocks never freezes into a bond, the right block slides straight off the contact and the left one stays on the table without moving; in the counterfactual a white frozen seam grows across the contact face, the bond carries the friction between the left block and the table, and the left block is dragged along with the right one.

title.zh: 坡角越过静止角塌落
title.en: A cone of sand that slumps past its angle of repose

description.zh: 粗砂经漏斗倒在浅圆托盘上，堆成比砂能静止的坡角更陡的锥。True 里倒完之后锥面撑不住，顶点塌下、底盘摊开，最后停在砂真正能静止的浅角上；反事实里砂粒之间不滑，锥体保持原来的陡度和高度。
description.en: Coarse sand pours through a funnel onto a shallow round tray and piles into a cone steeper than the angle the sand can hold. In the true clip the cone cannot stand once the pouring stops: the top collapses, the base spreads out and it settles at the shallow angle the sand can really hold; in the counterfactual the grains do not slide past each other and the cone keeps its original steepness and height.

title.zh: 纸飞机自己摊开了
title.en: A paper plane that unfolds by itself

description.zh: 折好的纸飞机放在深色桌垫上，两个小夹翼爪松开并退开。真值里飞机保持机头、机身和两翼，整段不变。反事实里没有任何操作，折叠结构突然一下松开，摊成桌垫上的一张纸。
description.en: A folded paper plane lies on a dark desk mat and two small clip jaws release and withdraw. In the true clip the plane keeps its nose, its body and its two wings for the whole clip; in the counterfactual nothing is done to it, the folded structure lets go in one sudden move and the plane opens out into a flat sheet on the mat.

title.zh: 墙钉上的画歪着停住
title.en: A picture that settles crooked the other way

description.zh: 一幅画用一枚钉子和一根钢丝挂在灰泥墙上，重心正好落在钉子正下方，所以它横平竖直地挂着、整段一动不动；反事实在同一幅画上给出一个平衡偏移，画面绕钉子转开、摆起来，最后歪着停在右下角低的一侧。
description.en: A framed picture hangs on a plaster wall from a nail and a wire, its centre of mass exactly below the nail, so it hangs square and still for the whole clip; the counterfactual puts a small balance offset into the same picture, the frame turns away from the nail, swings and comes to rest crooked with the lower right corner down.

title.zh: 旗子顺风往下游飘
title.en: A banner the wind streams downstream

description.zh: 风按旗方程把旗面兜着往下游吹，True 里旗边低过挂杆；反事实只把旗面横风升力的符号取反，同一面旗子被朝反方向掀起，掀到旗杆上方去。
description.en: The wind fills the flag along the flag equation and blows it downstream, and in the true clip the free edge sits below the pole; the counterfactual only flips the sign of the crosswind lift, and the same flag is lifted the other way, up past the top of the pole.

title.zh: 带电气球从墙上掉下来了
title.en: A charged balloon that loses its grip on the wall

description.zh: 一只充了静电的气球贴在灰泥墙上，穿堂风经过时它只是歪一点，继续挂着；反事实里干燥气流把橡胶表面的电荷带走，气球脱墙，被风推着落到地上。地板上那只木箱是给气球当尺度的道具，不是抽样出来的轴。
description.en: A statically charged rubber balloon sticks to a plaster wall, and when a draught passes it only leans a little and stays attached; in the counterfactual the dry air carries the charge off the rubber, the balloon leaves the wall and is pushed down onto the floor. The wooden crate on the floor is a prop that gives the balloon its scale, not a sampled axis.

title.zh: 衣夹夹住毛巾，夹口没了摩擦
title.en: The clothespin holds the towel until the friction goes

description.zh: 一条晾衣绳横过画面，一只木衣夹夹在绳上，毛巾的一角被夹在夹口里。真值支里夹口与布之间的摩擦托住毛巾的重量，毛巾挂在绳上、随着夹口里的余力慢慢往下挪一点；反事实支里只去掉这一条摩擦，毛巾从夹口里滑出来掉到地上，落成地上的一堆。夹子、绳子、毛巾、灯光与机位两支完全相同。
description.en: A washing line runs across the frame, a wooden clothespin is clipped to it and one corner of a towel is caught in the jaws. In the true clip the friction between the jaws and the cloth carries the weight of the towel, so it hangs on the line and creeps down a little as the grip slackens; in the counterfactual only that friction is removed, the towel slides out of the jaws and falls to the floor in a heap. The clip, the line, the towel, the lighting and the camera are identical in both branches.

title.zh: 凿子顺木纹把木料劈开
title.en: A chisel that splits the timber along the grain

description.zh: 一根木料横放在工作台上，表面有顺着木纹的深色纹路；一把凿子斜着抵在木料的端面上被推进去。真值支里木料顺着木纹裂开，一道长缝顺着木料长度走到底，缝口张开；反事实支里木料的纤维之间不再咬合，凿子沿纤维滑过去，木料始终是一整根，端面上只留一个浅坑。
description.en: A length of timber lies across a workbench with dark grain lines running along it, and a chisel is set at an angle against its end face and pushed in. In the true clip the timber splits along the grain and a long crack runs the length of it and opens up; in the counterfactual the fibres no longer hold each other, the chisel slides along them and the timber stays in one piece with only a shallow pit on the end face.

title.zh: 手刨推出连续薄花
title.en: A hand plane that lifts one continuous shaving

description.zh: 一块木板平放在工作台上，一把木柄手刨沿着板子的近侧边缘被推过去，刨刃斜着嵌在刨身里，刃口就设在板子的那条边上，所以刨出来的薄花从刨口越过板子边缘、顺着板子的侧面垂到台面上。真值支里刨刃把木头整片剪下来，出来的是一条不断的薄花，挂在板子边上再落在台面上；反事实支里刃口前的木头不是被剪下而是崩碎，同一条带上出来的是一颗颗小碎屑，落在板子边上与台面上，画面上没有那条连续的带子。
description.en: A board lies flat on a workbench and a wooden hand plane is pushed along its near edge, the iron set at an angle in the body with its edge right on that edge of the board, so the shaving leaves the mouth, crosses the edge of the board and hangs down its side onto the bench. In the true clip the iron cuts the wood away as a whole and what comes out is one unbroken shaving that hangs over the edge and drops onto the bench; in the counterfactual the wood in front of the edge does not get cut away but breaks up, and out of the same strip come small chips that land on the edge of the board and on the bench — the continuous band is simply not there.

title.zh: 冰壶在冰面上拐弯
title.en: A curling stone that curls across the ice

description.zh: 一整片淡蓝色的冰面铺满画面，一块花岗岩冰壶带着红色把手滑出去，壶体一边自转一边滑行。真值支里冰壶越滑越慢，旋转的刃口把它推向侧面，它划出一条弯的路线，末了把手偏离了出发时的那条线；反事实支里旋转的刃口不再把冰壶推向侧面，冰壶直着走完，把手一直指着出发时的那条线。
description.en: A pale blue sheet of ice fills the frame and a granite curling stone with a red handle slides away, spinning as it goes. In the true clip the stone slows down, the rotating running band pushes it sideways and it follows a curved path, so the handle ends up off the line it started on; in the counterfactual the rotating running band no longer pushes the stone sideways, it runs straight across the ice and the handle keeps pointing along the line it started on.

title.zh: 立着的硬币自己倒平
title.en: A coin on its edge that falls flat by itself

description.zh: 一张桌面上立着一枚硬币，硬币竖着边缘立在桌面上，一边自转一边微微倾斜。真值支里硬币的边缘磨着桌面，转速被磨掉，倾角越来越大，最后硬币拍平躺在桌面上；反事实支里硬币的边缘不再磨桌面，转速不掉，倾角不再变大，硬币整段直立着转完，末了仍然立在边缘上。
description.en: A coin stands on its edge on a table, spinning slowly and leaning a little further as it goes. In the true clip the rim grinds against the table, the spin is worn away, the lean grows and the coin finally slaps flat onto the surface; in the counterfactual the rim no longer grinds the table, the spin is not worn away, the lean does not grow and the coin spins upright for the whole clip, still standing on its edge at the end.
